source_row.rationale: Symptoms and focal lung findings can raise suspicion for community-acquired pneumonia, but clinical findings alone do not establish etiology. ATS/IDSA CAP guidance applies to adults with clinically suspected and radiographically confirmed pneumonia. The revised item therefore asks for suspicion and evaluation rather than claiming the symptom cluster alone confirms CAP.
source_row.source_detail: Official ATS/IDSA guideline, published October 1, 2019 with additional resources updated through 2023; guideline management framework addresses clinically suspected and radiographically confirmed CAP.
source_row.source_name: ATS/IDSA — Diagnosis and Treatment of Adults with Community-Acquired Pneumonia
source_row.stem: An adult has fever, productive cough, pleuritic chest pain, focal crackles, and no obvious alternative diagnosis. What is the most appropriate interpretation?
